title: Non-blocking follow-ups from backend-profit-target-open-position PR #224 review
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #224 (backend-profit-target-open-position), recorded here per CLAUDE.md's convention so they aren't lost once the PR merges. The review's blocking findings (a stop-value inconsistency between RiskPosition.protective_stop and RiskPosition.profit_target's own internal stop, and the frontend never consuming the new field) are tracked directly on backend-profit-target-open-position's own review.comments and must be fixed there before that PR merges -- they are not duplicated here since that task isn't done yet.

checklist.step: GET /api/portfolio/risk now runs a full whole-history support/resistance detection pass (detect_support_resistance_zones) plus a second full weekly-Autoenvelope + swing-low pass (inside suggest_profit_target) for every position on every request, uncached -- none of which existed on this endpoint before this task. If this endpoint is polled (RiskPanel's usage suggests it is), this multiplies per-poll CPU cost by N extra heavy passes with no memoization, unlike the already-computed stops/daily_by_id/weekly_by_id this same loop deliberately caches for reuse within one request. Not a correctness issue at today's data sizes, but worth reconsidering (e.g. caching profit_target per (ticker, as-of-date) the way OHLCV itself is cached) if this endpoint's polling frequency or position count grows.
